title: A later explicit Companion run supersedes the current proposal and reuses active attention

given.plant: active and authorized for a granted Engineer with can_operate=true
given.attention: active and pointing to one pending proposal

when.command: the Engineer explicitly invokes Companion for that issue
when.result: the provider-neutral runtime returns a valid newly classified proposal through explicit Companion and Safety test fake/spy seams

then.proposal: the previous proposal becomes superseded and the new proposal becomes the only pending proposal
then.attention: the same attention row points to the new proposal and remains active
then.authority: neither proposal enters Agent Chat Bus or creates a DecisionRecord or Task
